0.title: How designed binders reached a sugar
0.caption: The latent generative search pipeline and what it validated. Numbers from Didi et al., bioRxiv, 2026. Press a number to step through it.
steps: A generative model builds sequence and backbone together in one shared latent space, with no separate inverse-folding step.
A reward-guided search steers the model while designs are being generated, rather than filtering them afterwards.
More than a million designs were screened by multiplexed phage display; the method yielded more validated binders than any other compared.
Validated hits include therapeutic receptors, a viral attachment protein, intracellular signalling proteins - and a de novo protein binding a free sugar that tells blood-group antigens apart.

1.title: What is inside Tahoe-100M
1.caption: How the Tahoe-100M perturbation atlas was built and what it measures. Numbers from Zhang et al., Cell, 2026. Press a number to step through it.
steps: 50 cancer cell lines are pooled into balanced 'cell villages' on the Mosaic platform rather than run separately.
The villages are exposed to 1,100 drug-dose conditions in parallel, with minimal batch effects reported.
The readout is 100 million single-cell transcriptomes, released publicly as training material for predictive models.
Pathway-level signatures give phenotypes, mechanism of action, off-target activity and adaptive stress responses tied to resistance.

2.title: How prime assembly installs DNA
2.caption: Schematic of CRISPR-targeted dual flap synthesis and integration, from Levesque et al., Nature, 2026. Press a number to step through it.
steps: Two RNA-programmed CRISPR prime edits nick opposite strands of the target site and synthesise complementary DNA flaps, with no double-strand break.
The flaps pair with an incoming single- or double-stranded DNA fragment, assembling the new sequence in place.
The sequence is integrated at the target, reported to work comparably in dividing and non-dividing cells, for exon recoding, transgenes and megabase rearrangements.

3.title: How xvr aligns a scan in seconds
3.caption: The patient-specific training and registration loop of xvr. Numbers from Gopalakrishnan et al., Nature, 2026. Press a number to step through it.
steps: The patient's own preoperative scan is turned into training X-rays by physics-based simulation, with no manual annotation.
A foundation model pretrained on thousands of whole-body scans adapts to the new region in about five minutes of fine-tuning.
The fine-tuned network then registers the 3D volume to live fluoroscopy in seconds, improving accuracy on existing methods by an order of magnitude.
